user.title: Connect to Audiobookshelf
user.description: Enter the address of your Audiobookshelf server and an API token. In Audiobookshelf, go to Settings → Users, open your user and copy the API token (on 2.26 and newer, Settings → API Keys).

data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off only if your server uses a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Audiobookshelf
reauth_confirm.description: The API token for {url} is no longer accepted. Enter a new one.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Audiobookshelf
reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant connects to your Audiobookshelf server. The new details must belong to the same Audiobookshelf user.

data_description.token: Leave blank to keep the current token.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off only if your server uses a self-signed certificate.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the server. Check the address, the port and that Home Assistant can see it.
error.invalid_url: That does not look like a valid URL.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
error.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Audiobookshelf user. To track another user, add the integration again instead.

abort.already_configured: This Audiobookshelf user is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the server.
data_description.max_items: How many books to keep in the in progress, finished and recently added lists.
data_description.active_window: How recently progress must have been synced for the Listening sensor to be on.
data_description.libraries: Which libraries to include in the recently added list. Leave empty for all of them.
data_description.public_url: Address to use when opening a book from the card, if it differs from the URL Home Assistant connects to.

mark_finished.name: Mark finished
mark_finished.description: Mark a library item as finished for the connected Audiobookshelf user.

episode_id.name: Episode ID
episode_id.description: The podcast episode ID, if the item is a podcast.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Which Audiobookshelf server to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

mark_unfinished.name: Mark unfinished
mark_unfinished.description: Mark a library item as unfinished and rewind it to the beginning.

episode_id.name: Episode ID
episode_id.description: The podcast episode ID, if the item is a podcast.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Which Audiobookshelf server to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

set_progress.name: Set progress
set_progress.description: Move the playback position of a library item. Give either a time in seconds or a percentage, not both.

current_time.name: Position
current_time.description: Playback position in seconds from the start of the item.

percent.name: Percent
percent.description: Playback position as a percentage of the item's duration.

episode_id.name: Episode ID
episode_id.description: The podcast episode ID, if the item is a podcast.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Which Audiobookshelf server to use. Only needed if you have more than one.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Poll Audiobookshelf immediately instead of waiting for the next update.

config_entry_id.name: Server
config_entry_id.description: Which Audiobookshelf server to refresh. Omit to refresh all of them.
